description:
Fetch a merchant's UCP discovery doc from /.well-known/ucp. Works
against any UCP-compliant merchant; defaults to https://www.0ncore.com.

Returns the merchant's name, supported capabilities (catalog, checkout,
fulfillment, identity, orders), payment handlers, currencies, and
categories. Use this to figure out what endpoints to call next.

merchant.description: Merchant base URL (e.g. https://www.0ncore.com). Defaults to UCP_MERCHANT_URL env or 0ncore.com.

name: ucp_discover
